title: CYBER-OVER: Memory Horizon
summary: Built **CYBER-OVER: Memory Horizon**, a full multiplayer revival of *Rockman Xover* featuring auto-scrolling action stages with 3-tier piercing Charge Shots (Blue/Yellow/Red), 6-beam screen-clearing Giga Crushes, a 28-segment stage distance bar, AutoPlay, and magnetized Zenny/Battle Memory/EP/Map Part drops. Added turn-based Boss Battles, 4-player co-op Master Boss Raids, Battle Tower, and 1v1 Battle Arena PvP alongside OVER-1 through OVER-10 armor customization, glowing color-matched Bonus Line card decks, Card Enhancement, Gacha pulls, and live multiplayer Bulk Cheers.
